note.fr: Tous les candidats doivent réussir un processus d'évaluation d'aptitude (Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren) comprenant un test en ligne (mathématiques, résolution de problèmes).
note.en: All applicants must pass a qualification assessment process (Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren) including an online test (mathematics, problem solving).

evidence.quote: All applicants to the BSc AI have to pass a qualification assessment process ("Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren"), which includes an online test in English with questions on mathematics and problem solving.

note.fr: L'admission repose sur des points : note du diplôme d'accès à l'université et test en ligne. Moins de 140 points : non apte ; au moins 140 points : apte.
note.en: Admission uses a points system: university entrance qualification grade and online test. Less than 140 points: not suitable; at least 140 points: suitable.

evidence.quote: Applicants who achieve less than 140 points are unfortunately not suitable for the degree program.
